source_notes: The Aug 2025 CHEC award is explicitly for a FLOATING storage & regasification unit (FSRU) at offshore Kerawalapitiya under a BOO (vessel) / BOOT (mooring) model. The Ceylon Electricity Board RFP (primary) is titled 'deployment of floating storage and regasification unit (FSRU) at offshore Kerawalapitiya'; Upstream headline = 'Tender launched for Sri Lanka LNG floater'. GEM currently has Floating blank for this terminal. Floating field has no paired [ref] column in the 115-col schema (ref_field intentionally empty). Note: FloatingVesselName is NOT set — vessel not yet chartered/built, consistent with leaving it blank (same pattern as Hsieh-Ho).
